title: Moroccan Lamb Sellou
description: A rich and flavorful Moroccan dessert made with lamb, sellou, and spices, perfect for special occasions.
instructions: In a large saucepan, mix together sellou, warm water, and honey. Heat over medium heat, stirring constantly, until the mixture thickens.
Add the ground lamb to the saucepan and cook until browned, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
Stir in the Moroccan spices, pistachios, and rose water. Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and stir in the unsalted butter until melted.
Transfer the mixture to a serving dish and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow it to set.
Serve chilled, garnished with additional pistachios if desired.
